newsitem.title: USA: Taubman increases unsecured credit line.
newsitem.headline: Taubman increases unsecured credit line.

text.p: Taubman Centers Inc said Wednesday it had increased the unsecured revolving credit line of its Taubman Realty Group L.P. to $300 million from $200 million.

The company also extended the maturity from May 1998 to March 2000. Also included in the credit line is a competitive bid option that allows the group to hold auctions for short-term funds for up to $150 million.
Taubman Centers, a real estate investment trust, is the managing general partner of TRG, which owns, develops, acquires and operates regional shopping centers nationally.
The company's portfolio includes 21 urban and suburban regional and super-regional shopping centers in 11 states.
